description: Email a reply to a lead/enquiry (comms scope); marks it read. A reply to an OUTREACH lead (someone who answered a cold email) goes out from the mailbox that emailed them, in the same email thread, and their next answer comes back into ActBook; the result's `from` says which address was used and `note` explains a fallback (that mailbox paused or disconnected). mailbox_id picks a different From. Optionally pass client_id to log the reply to that client's history. dry_run=true previews, including the From.

body.description: The message or email body (HTML or text, per the tool).

client_id.description: A client's id (from search or list_clients).

dry_run.description: If true, preview the result without sending or saving anything.

id.description: The record's numeric id, from the matching list/get/search tool.

name: reply_to_inquiry
title: Reply To Inquiry
